answer: Random-Order Activation Lottery: each new agent ID must claim an activation slot whose order is drawn from a public verifiable random function seeded at dawn each day, before identities are submitted. Slots resolve in that order; only agents whose slot lands inside the registration canyon (a fixed percentile band) become active, and each pays a per-attempt randomness-beacon fee plus a fresh hardware-attested key, akin to discarding a relic each try.
